name: shield
description: AI-powered security scanner for git repos. Ships the shield CLI, an MCP server, and a REST/dashboard server (shield-serve) over a package-owned local SQLite store at ~/.hasna/security/shield.db. The server's active data backend is SQLite; PostgreSQL is declared as the forward-looking engine capability with an environment-gated live proof (pgTestGate).

serviceSurfaces.name: shield-sdk
serviceSurfaces.deferReason: The hand-written ./sdk client is not generated from an OpenAPI document: the API surface is deferred (shield-serve does not yet serve GET /health, GET /ready, GET /version or /openapi.json), so the SDK cannot claim a contract-bound supported status with generatedFrom.

serviceSurfaces.name: shield-api
serviceSurfaces.deferReason: shield-serve exposes /api/* over localhost only and does not yet serve the contract topology (GET /health, GET /ready, GET /version) or publish an OpenAPI document. Declaring it supported would assert endpoints this build does not answer.

conformance.notes: storage.engines postgresql is validator-forced: the kit refuses a waivedStorageEngines waiver for a service-capable cli-with-store shipping shield-serve (measured). The PostgreSQL backend is NOT implemented in this repo (no DATABASE_URL handling in src; bun:sqlite throughout) — the declaration and its pgTestGate are recorded in the census CONTRACTS_EXCEPTIONS entry and must be removed when the schema permits an honest waiver.
